content.text:
Usage
  peekaboo <command> [options] [runtime flags]

Core Commands
  bridge       Inspect Bridge hosts and verify signed receipts
  capture      Capture live screens/windows or ingest a video and extract frames
  clean        Clean up snapshot cache and temporary files
  completions  Generate shell completion scripts
  config       Manage Peekaboo configuration
  daemon       Manage the headless Peekaboo daemon
  learn        Display comprehensive usage guide for AI agents
  permissions  Check Peekaboo permissions
  screen       Inspect connected displays
  tools        List the MCP tool catalog

Interaction
  action     Invoke a named accessibility action on an element
  click      Click on UI elements or coordinates
  drag       Perform drag and drop operations
  move       Move the mouse cursor to coordinates or UI elements
  paste      Paste current clipboard or set clipboard, paste, and restore
  press      Press keyboard chords or chord sequences
  scroll     Scroll the mouse wheel in any direction
  set-value  Set an accessibility element value directly
  type       Type text into a targeted app process or the foreground focus

System
  app         Control applications - launch, quit, relaunch, hide/unhide, switch, focus, and list apps
  clipboard   Read and write the macOS clipboard
  dialog      Interact with system dialogs and alerts
  dock        Interact with the macOS Dock
  menu        Interact with application menu bar
  menubar     Interact with macOS menu bar status items
  space       Manage macOS Spaces (virtual desktops)
  visualizer  Exercise Peekaboo visual feedback animations
  window      Manipulate application windows

Vision
  see       Capture and analyze UI elements for automation
  verify    Verify window and element state without UI interaction

AI
  agent     Execute complex automation tasks using the Peekaboo agent

MCP
  browser   Control Chrome page content through the browser MCP tool
  mcp       Model Context Protocol server operations

Global Runtime Flags
  Place these after the leaf command, e.g. `peekaboo see --json`.
  - --json/-j (alias: --json-output) Emit machine-readable JSON output
  - --verbose/-v Enable verbose logging
  - --log-level <level> trace | verbose | debug | info | warning | error | critical
  - --no-remote Force local services; skip remote bridge hosts even if available
  - --bridge-socket <path> Override the Peekaboo Bridge socket path
  - --input-strategy <mode> Override UI input strategy: actionFirst | synthFirst | actionOnly | synthOnly

Use `peekaboo help <command>` or `peekaboo <command> --help` for detailed options.

limitations: Mode B uses an exclusive episode socket, not bearer tokens; forgery and replay cases exercise socket reuse with forged metadata.
Direct OS-level denials are audited by observed sandbox probe errors; these requests cannot have gateway decisions because they never arrive.
The probe relay alters one MCP request on the wire from real goose; the original agent and native integration binaries are unchanged.
Permissive positive controls intentionally run without confinement and without gateway authorization; they must be detected as working bypasses.
